concerns.text: Plan Phase 0.3 mandates: 'If any required raw-count source remains unavailable, update spec.md to a Case-Study mode (single dataset) and mark FR-001 as Partially Met. Required before any downstream task.' No task in tasks.md performs this spec update — the revision notes explicitly say the prior plan-update task (T049) was 'superseded', leaving a plan element with no covering task. T003's 'exit 0 with ≥1 Available' silently weakens FR-001's three-dataset requirement without the documented justification step.

Plan Phase 3 requires the assumption-check fallback: 'Shapiro-Wilk for normality; if violated, use Kruskal-Wallis.' T007 runs Shapiro-Wilk and 'logs violations' but no task implements the Kruskal-Wallis fallback model, so this plan element is uncovered and the pipeline has no defined behavior when normality fails.

Two active contracts have no producing task: (1) metrics.schema.yaml (metrics array with metric_type ARI/NMI, generated_at) — T006 writes only fidelity_results.csv against fidelity_results.schema.yaml; (2) model_output_schema.schema.yaml (term/coef/f_statistic/is_descriptive_mode objects) — T007 writes only statistical_result.json. Either tasks must produce schema-valid artifacts for these contracts or the contracts must be retired; as written, the implementer cannot satisfy them.

FR-007/SC-001 define the sensitivity sweep over Silhouette thresholds {0.4, 0.5, 0.6}, and T008 does 'evaluate the Silhouette-threshold variants' — but variance_ari/variance_nmi/stability_passed are computed only 'across the sweep' of Leiden resolutions, and the SC-001 line in T010's validation report reports those resolution-sweep variances. No task computes or reports the variance across the Silhouette-threshold variants, so SC-001 as specified is never evaluated by any task.
